basis: May 9, 2024 is the earliest public document I verified that establishes the threshold. Q1 consolidated GAAP total revenue was $153,175,000 versus $162,092,000 a year earlier, down 5.50% and $812,400 below the $153,987,400 cutoff. The April 24 release gave product sales only. I located the official materials for the intervening May 6 shareholder meeting, but they do not establish what management said or distributed that day. The earliest public disclosure date therefore remains unresolved.

coverage.detail: October 25, 2023 Q3 release. Management expected earlier Halloween shipments to reduce Q4 2023 sales relative to the prior-year quarter. It gave no numeric Q1 2024 revenue outlook.
February 16, 2024 Q4 release. Management reported Q4 2023 net sales of $195,368,000 and discussed pricing and supply conditions. It gave no numeric Q1 2024 revenue outlook.
The intervening 2023 Form 10-K discussed Q1 2024 timing for Canadian labor negotiations. I found no Q1 revenue bound.

The April 24 release reported $151,464,000 versus $160,711,000. Both amounts match the 10-Q’s net product sales row. Total revenue would qualify only if Q1 2024 rental and royalty revenue was at most $2,523,400. The release gave no figure or ceiling for that component.

The issuer’s proxy on its designated materials host identifies an in-person annual meeting at noon EDT on May 6 at One James Center, Suite 200, Richmond, Virginia. It lists director elections, auditor ratification and possible other business. The notice provides no webcast or replay address.
The host’s 2024 proxy card confirms the event and identifies the portal as a source for proxy materials. It contains voting instructions and no account of management’s remarks.

The portal yielded no meeting recording, transcript or deck. Its https://www.astproxyportal.com/ast/14960/Download and https://www.astproxyportal.com/ast/14960/Request%20Materials links returned 404. Its https://www.astproxyportal.com/ast/14960/Print link returned 403.
The attempted historical portal lookup was inaccessible. I could not verify what the portal displayed on the meeting date.

I checked the issuer’s financial archive and searched outside EDGAR for preliminary or updated guidance, Q1 calls, investor presentations and May 6 remarks. I found no dated issuer or event-hosted recording, transcript or deck establishing Q1 total revenue before May 9.
The May 10 Form 8-K confirms the May 6 meeting occurred and reports the votes on directors and the auditor. It gives no account of financial remarks.
The meeting filing’s exhibit inventory lists no presentation, transcript or EX-99. The filing cannot resolve what attendees heard.

Page 5 of the issuer-hosted Q1 Form 10-Q reconciles both quarters. Rental and royalty revenue of $1,711,000 and $1,381,000 brings product sales to consolidated total revenue of $153,175,000 and $162,092,000, respectively. I could not verify an earlier posting date for this copy.
EDGAR records acceptance of the 10-Q on May 9, 2024 at 15:00:40 for the quarter ended March 31, 2024.

publication_date_evidence: The Q1 earnings exhibit is marked for immediate release on April 24. EDGAR establishes May 9 as the public filing date for the consolidated actual recorded in upper_bound. The proxy, proxy card and voting report verify the May 6 event, but none establishes whether a qualifying figure became public there.
